title: GENERATIVE ADVERSARIAL REVIEWS: WHEN LLMS BECOME THE CRITIC

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the score distributions of various LLM-based reviewers using violin plots to detect if models exhibit a skewed, overly positive inclination to accept manuscripts compared to human standards.
Evaluating how simulated reviewer personas with varying levels of domain knowledge (Novice, Intermediate, Expert) impact the accuracy, depth, and consistency of paper acceptance predictions.

Calculating the relative log frequency ratio of 11 specific feedback aspects (e.g., missing citations, theoretical soundness, reproducibility) to measure whether LLM reviewers systematically over- or under-emphasize certain review categories compared to human reviewers.
